about: Wording fixes that came out of the Wikipedia source check of the recent shelf, Nov 12 2026. See source-check-2026-11-12.md for what was read.

edits.old: This Australian retired in 2022 at 25, ranked No. 1 and weeks after winning her home major
edits.new: This Australian retired in 2022 at 25, ranked No. 1 and two months after winning her home major
edits.why: Her page says she retired in March 2022, 'just two months after her Australian Open title'.

edits.old: In 2025 this Compton rapper performed 'Not Like Us' as the first solo hip-hop headliner
edits.new: In 2025 this Compton rapper performed 'Not Like Us' at halftime, one week after the song won five Grammys
edits.why: The halftime show's page does not say 'first solo hip-hop headliner'. The five Grammys (2 Feb 2025) and the show (9 Feb 2025) are both on pages that were read.
